summary: Implemented the engine-free CSV and NIfTI savers, the plot_2d_or_3d_image function, and thin adapters for the segmentation, classification, and TensorBoard image handlers. Updated the NIfTI writer default dtype, renamed output_path to output_dir in two examples and the sliding-window integration test, and updated the classification handler test. Added four new test files (test_csv_saver.py, test_nifti_saver.py, test_handler_segmentation_saver.py, test_plot_2d_or_3d_image.py). Nothing was run: tests, flake8, and the ignite 0.3.0 attach path are unverified. Only mechanical lint checks (line length, trailing whitespace, file endings) were done by reading. Nothing is committed.
